_README: VENDORED snapshot of the orchestrator's shared connection-type vocabulary (Data-Flow-Advisory/orchestrator @ feat/drift-gate:types.json), plus the spec-task-pipeline types organ-spec-tasks PROPOSES for upstream review (each flagged "proposed": true). Vendored because the conformance Action's GITHUB_TOKEN is scoped to this repo and cannot read the orchestrator's (unmerged-branch) file. Once the proposed types land in the canonical types.json, drop the flags and re-sync this snapshot. Two organ ports connect iff their `type` matches. See CONNECTORS.md.

TenantContext.desc: A resolved tenant: identity, branding, provenance bag.

SiteCrawl.desc: Signals crawled from a prospect's website at signup.

InterviewTranscript.desc: Ordered Q&A pairs from a discovery interview.

KeyFacts.desc: Themed facts extracted from a transcript (the discovery memory).

EntityGraph.desc: Deduplicated canonical entities (people, systems, tools) per tenant.

Blueprint.desc: The system blueprint: modules + integrations + current/recommended state.

ProcessFlow.desc: Sequence / swimlane of a workflow extracted from transcript themes.

AccountState.desc: A fleet account's pacing/quota state (the pace + drift gates' input).

ClaimVerdict.desc: Whether a worker may claim work now, and why (gate output).

BillingState.desc: A tenant's subscription / billing state + feature entitlements.

ConformanceVerdict.desc: Whether an organ/output conforms + groundedness (self_metric shape).

ApparatusSource.desc: A pointer to something the fresh apparatus should scan for useful specs/features — the OLD apparatus or any source.

RawArtefacts.desc: Raw scanned content from a source, before it is decomposed into discrete features.

CandidateFeatures.desc: Discrete specs/features decomposed out of the raw scan — the candidates to judge.

JudgedFeatures.desc: Candidates after judgment — the useful ranked, the useless rejected (reject is first-class).

ProvenancedArtefact.desc: Any spec/feature the scan-and-select takes from the OLD apparatus, wrapped with its origin + succession status so the new machine knows it as inherited, never native. Retain history, know it as such — succession baked in, the antidote to old-artefacts-polluting-new. See FRESH_APPARATUS.md.

SpecTask.desc: A single task in a technical spec's execution graph: an addressable unit of build work with its dependencies, acceptance criteria and current execution status. Element of SpecTaskGraph; emitted as the next task to claim.

SpecTaskGraph.desc: The ordered task DAG of an approved technical spec — the task definitions a worker sequences through. An array of SpecTask definitions, declaration-ordered (the claim scan is order-preserving).

TaskStateMap.desc: Per-task execution state for a spec, keyed by task id. A task with no slot defaults to pending. completed_pending_review counts as terminal-done for both dependency satisfaction and the spec roll-up.

ApprovalGate.desc: The human approval gate on a spec: True once an operator has approved the spec so its tasks become claimable. Mirrors claim_next_task's PermissionError-on-unapproved hard gate.

SpecSequenceDecision.desc: The single next action a worker should take against a spec's task graph — the sequencing verdict.
